corrections.reason: Classical Ge'ez verb is ኬደ ('he trod/stepped', matching L14 ወኬደ); the 5th-order loop on the right leg of ኬ is clearly visible in the print.
The printed glyph is 6th-order ት (ምሥጢረ ምሕረት), with the following word-separator dots slightly bleeding near the right side of the cross-bar.
Classical Ge'ez 3rd person feminine singular suffix is -ታ (ዘውስቴታ), not the Amharic labialized ቷ; the image clearly shows ታ matching line 22.
Translating the Ge'ez distal demonstrative ለእንታክቲ ('that'), the printed word is ያችን (matching L26 ያችን), with 4th-order ያ.
The first character has the 5th-order ring at the bottom of the right leg (ሄጄ), not the 3rd-order foot of ሂ.
